I saved Tobias's figure to the shared knowledge base: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is for 382 seats. I also replied in Tobias's thread in #central-team to confirm it's recorded.

Before saving, I checked the knowledge base and found no earlier seat count for the account, so this doesn't contradict anything. One limit: the knowledge base only matches exact words right now, so a seat count written in different terms could have been missed.

A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so the rules on sharing finance figures didn't apply.
